agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
March 4, 2026, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minutes approval for February 4, 2026, Planning Commission meeting.

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR:
  Unless called upon by a Planning Commissioner, these items will be
  acted upon as a whole.

  a. Adoption of the Planning Commission Public Rules of Decorum.

  Recommendation:
  Consider the staff report, any testimony and make a determination.
  It is recommended that you:
  1) Approve the Planning Commission Public Rules of Decorum; or
  2) Deny the Planning Commission Public Rules of Decorum.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A one-year review and assessment of SUP23-00005 approved on July
  5, 2023 to allow 1) beer and wine and 2) distilled spirits for
  off-site consumption from an approximately 2,300 square-foot
  convenience market within a shopping center on an approximately
  22,200 square-foot, C-2(General Commercial) zoned property.

  Recommendation:
  Consider the staff report and any testimony and make a
  determination. Based on the Planning Commission determination, it
  is recommended that you:
  1) Affirm the approval of Resolution No. 1965 dated July 5, 2023;
  or
  2) Approve with additional conditions to Resolution No. 1965; or
  3) Revoke SUP23-00005
  Item 6b Documents

7.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider Zoning Code Amendment No. 26-00001
  (ZCA26-00001) to modify miscellaneous regulations in Chapter 12
  of the Inglewood Municipal Code (IMC) related to the Medical
  Enterprise Overlay Zone (MEOZ), Inglewood International Business
  Park (IIBP) Specific Plan, and Parking for Major Event Patrons,
  Citywide.
  Item 7a Documents

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-015) has been prepared
  findings that the proposed project is categorically exempt from
  the California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division Office on
  the fourth floor of City Hall or electronically by request at
  rbrooks@cityofinglewood.org.
   Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to recommend this Code
  Amendment for adoption, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-015;
  2) Adopt the resolution recommending ZCA26-00001 to the City
  Council
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to modify the
  recommended Code Amendment for adoption, it is recommended
  to:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-015;
  2) Adopt the resolution as amended recommending the City
  Council adopt ZCA26-00001

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Travis Albini,
  representing Chick-fil-A, for Special Use Permit No. 25-
  00024(SUP25-00024) to allow a proposed 5,031 square-foot fast
  food restaurant with a drive-through and outdoor dining within
  a shopping center on a C-2 (General Commercial) zoned property
  at 3003 West Manchester Boulevard.
  This item is postponed to March 17, 2026.

8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

9.  Commission Initiatives.

10.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of March 4, 2026, is
not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item
being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item
will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, APRIL 1, 2026, AT 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
